description: Add an article that is already written (for example, one drafted in this conversation) to the website's Content Hub as an editable draft. Same as pasting it into the Content Hub's blank editor: no AI model runs and no content credits are spent. Use create_content instead when Athena should research and write the piece. body is the full article in Markdown and is stored as given, except that link and image destinations with an unsafe scheme (javascript:, data:) become #. The item is created with type manual at stage generated, and the body is recorded as version 1, so get_content_draft, edit_content, revise_content and get_content_versions work on it right away. Pass title, or it is taken from the body's first heading (else its first line). sheet_id must be a tab from get_content_hub_sheets: a sheet-type tab keeps the item, a view-type tab or no sheet_id puts it in the shared pool. The item is not published. Once it is live on the site, call publish_content with its URL to start citation tracking.
name: add_content
